These 6 GitHub repos are worth bookmarking in your first year.

Developer Roadmap — https://github.com/nilbuild/developer-roadmap — 372k stars on GitHub
App Ideas — https://github.com/florinpop17/app-ideas — 98.6k stars on GitHub
Project-Based Learning — https://github.com/practical-tutorials/project-based-learning — 290k stars on GitHub
Build Your Own X — https://github.com/codecrafters-io/build-your-own-x — 562k stars on GitHub
First Contributions — https://github.com/firstcontributions/first-contributions — 56.8k stars on GitHub
Interview University — https://github.com/jwasham/coding-interview-university — 364k stars on GitHub

Save this and star one repo tonight. Send it to the friend who opens GitHub and does not know where to start.
